# Version 4.156.0
> **Rendering and platform renewal** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 brings Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing and Uno 7 integration alongside font and rendering fixes. Linux NoDependencies builds recover system-font discovery, Android continuous rendering follows display refresh, and Windows custom-font ownership is corrected. Review the platform minimums and GTK4 and Uno migration guidance before upgrading. The page also includes collected fixes beyond Release Candidate 1; preview summaries describe only their own shipments.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — The collected Apple updates ultimately require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15 for both native libraries. Raise application deployment targets to at least those versions, retaining any higher framework requirement. The earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native floors were superseded; they do not lower existing managed minimums. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Move Tizen consumers to Tizen 10** — New native builds and packages no longer support Tizen 8 or 9. Move applications to Tizen 10 and the net10.0-tizen10.0 package targets. Custom native builds require GCC 14.2 and support x64 or arm64, not the former Clang or 32-bit paths. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno assembly now requires .NET 10 and Uno 7. SKSwapChainPanel derives from Grid, renders through a CPU canvas and reports a null GRContext; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usage. Windows facades retain the ANGLE-backed control; DrawInBackground remains unsupported on Uno. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Replace the legacy Uno WasmShell pipeline** — Pre-Uno 7 WasmShell native-asset integration and per-platform Uno runtime packages are retired. Migrate to Uno 7's .NET SDK WebAssembly build path and Uno.Sdk-provided platform assets instead of the former WasmShell linker items. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Choose GTK4 logical coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now paints in physical pixels by default on high-density displays, matching the new SKGLArea. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical painting coordinates with full-resolution backing storage. GTK input coordinates remain logical, and RawInfo continues to describe physical pixels. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Pass valid encoded text buffer lengths** — Shared font text validation now rejects negative byte lengths with ArgumentOutOfRangeException and odd GlyphID byte counts with ArgumentException. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs to BreakText, glyph conversion, counting, measurement and text-path APIs. Valid and empty inputs keep their existing behavior. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Replace custom fork-specific WinRT builds** — The native cleanup retires the fork-specific WinRT target. Move custom builds using that target to a supported Windows configuration; desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK and NanoServer remain supported. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))
- **Pass one encoding unit to character-code conversion** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode now validates encoded byte width instead of string length. Use UTF-8 only for ASCII, UTF-16 for one BMP character, and UTF-32 for supplementary characters. Empty, multi-character and multi-unit inputs throw ArgumentException rather than being partially decoded. GetString(byte[], ...) now throws ArgumentNullException, not NullReferenceException, for null input. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 with upstream correctness updates** — Updates the renderer without adding C bridge exports. Subsequent collected fixes address clipped convex-path rasterization, reflected hairline caps, glyph bounds, text-atlas selection, glyph replay validation and Graphite readback and clipping. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631), [#5671](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5671))
- **More robust shaders and region construction** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, budgets region storage for subdivided conics, and prevents execution of partially constructed runtime-shader pipelines. Graphite also compares complete paint keys and preserves stroke bounds. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext and an opt-in render loop. GTK owns the GL context; use QueueRender to invalidate. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for GL dispatch. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies fonts work again** — Restores directory-backed system-font discovery without adding fontconfig. The default directory is /usr/share/fonts/, enabling family lookup and SKShaper construction when usable fonts are installed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **Bundled HarfBuzz stays isolated on Linux** — Binds internal HarfBuzz function calls to the bundled implementation, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Android continuous rendering follows display refresh** — Texture-backed GL views, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, pace automatic frames with Choreographer instead of unbounded swaps. Explicit requests remain independent, rendering stays on the GL worker, and missed display pulses coalesce rather than queue. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Correct native callback boolean widths** — Uses one-byte values for native Skia boolean callbacks and four-byte values for HarfBuzz hb_bool_t callbacks, while public managed delegates retain bool. This corrects callback ABI handling, including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Reliable WebAssembly linking and archive selection** — Selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11+, retaining 3.1.34 for .NET 8 and 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10. WebGPU C++ support moves into libSkiaSharp.a so application C sources no longer receive C++ flags; custom Graphite archives must be rebuilt with that support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Valid GLES pixel uploads** — Disables Ganesh's invalid BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration on GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged by this upload fix. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Image pixel copies avoid an intermediate allocation** — Valid managed pixel buffers use direct raster copying without an intermediate SKData allocation. Invalid-input behavior remains on the existing native validation path. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Windows custom-font and view resources are released** — DWriteCore custom fonts release application data after the last dependent typeface clone is disposed. WinUI GL teardown unbinds its own current EGL context before destroying the surface, allowing the retained native window and view to be collected. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))
- **Borrowed streams no longer remain retained after disposal** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. It does not dispose that borrowed stream; its caller remains responsible for disposal. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Native ownership and callback corrections** — Integrates corrections to optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership, and retains the OpenGL module behind cached Windows WGL function pointers. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))

## Platform

- **Refreshed Windows rendering dependencies** — Updates WinUI ANGLE to chromium/8118 and aligns library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 for MAUI 9/10 compatibility. Source native assets recognize portable win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64 RIDs. This does not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 keeps the native engine at 14.4.0. UTF-32 string input and feature formatting avoid intermediate allocations, callback boolean widths are corrected, and Apple/Tizen deployment requirements and .NET 11 WebAssembly archive selection follow the platform updates described above.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 4, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 added Uno 7 integration, display-paced Android rendering, font and stream lifetime fixes, and corrected callback boolean widths. Apple deployment floors rose to macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS and Mac Catalyst 15, with tighter font-buffer and data-copy validation.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10...v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It also aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and moved Tizen packages to Tizen 10.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0...v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)
